authoritative_records.name: Task
authoritative_records.owns: immutable attempt identity, kind (Local/WFM), current accepted plan, execution/review lifecycle, outcome and optional Objective membership

authoritative_records.name: TaskPlanRevision
authoritative_records.owns: accepted operational-plan chronology and reason/provenance without overwriting prior plans

authoritative_records.name: TaskExecutionEvidence
authoritative_records.owns: actual start/end/cancellation/outcome occurrence evidence independently from planning

authoritative_records.name: TaskRetryRelation
authoritative_records.owns: immutable predecessor/successor attempt lineage without identity reuse

authoritative_records.name: Objective
authoritative_records.owns: Maintenance Window identity, accepted Task membership, lifecycle/review state and stable tracking identity

authoritative_records.name: ObjectiveEnvelope
authoritative_records.owns: derived min-start/max-end projection over accepted member Task plans, not independently editable truth

authoritative_records.name: RegroupProposal
authoritative_records.owns: revision-bound non-authoritative proposed membership changes and exact impact diff

authoritative_records.name: HistoricalObjectiveProposal
authoritative_records.owns: reviewable structure suggested from terminal provider history without claiming execution

identity_rules: Local Task uses immutable internal identity and never receives a fabricated TK/provider identity.
WFM canonical Task No. remains its external/provider attempt identity while SOMA retains stable internal identity.
Retry always creates a new Task identity; correction never masquerades as retry.
Objective tracking identity is stable across reschedule/regroup operations.
Monthly ordinal is presentation-only and may recalculate without changing Objective identity.
projection_rules: Objective SR/RFC/Device context is derived through Task relationships and does not become duplicate Objective-owned relationship truth.
Objective envelope derives from member Task plans.
Objective aggregate execution/outcome derives from member Task execution/outcome facts.
Operational-count inclusion/exclusion is a reporting projection and never deletes history.
